Index.harnessMetaTitle: DeepSeek Harness | Explore the limits of intelligence
Index.harnessMetaDesc: Use DeepSeek Harness to work with documents, analyze spreadsheets, write code, and schedule tasks. Extend its capabilities with composable plugins.
Index.harnessHeroDesc: Everyday rentals, multiple locations, or your next rental category—it starts here.
Index.harnessHeroDesc2: Rental OS brings multi-category rental businesses together, with an extensible Rental Core that connects bookings, inventory, fulfillment, and settlement.
Index.harnessHeroScreenshotAlt: DeepSeek Harness desktop interface with workspace sidebar and chat input
Index.harnessWhyTitle: Your business grows. You stay in control.
Index.harnessWhyP1: The model is the soul of an agent.
Index.harnessWhyP2: A harness lets an agent understand its environment, use tools, and keep working in real-world settings.
Index.harnessPillar1Desc: The Cordis kernel manages plugin mounting, unmounting, and dependencies. Agent capabilities live in the plugins.
Index.harnessPillar2Desc: Plugins provide every agent capability, including models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling, and the UI. Cordis services and events let the plugins work together.
Index.harnessPillar3Desc: Developers can select, swap, or extend any capability in configuration without changing the DeepSeek Harness source code.
Index.harnessFeatTitle:
Everything is a plugin.
Every run is traceable.
Index.harnessFeat1DescSuffix: 's plugin system. Plugins provide every agent capability, including models, tools, skills, sessions, sandboxes, storage, loops, scheduling, and the UI. Cordis services and events let the plugins work together. Developers can select, swap, or extend any capability in configuration without changing the DeepSeek Harness source code.
Index.harnessFeat1Alt: Compose models, tools, storage, and the agent loop through Cordis configuration
Index.harnessFeat1ScreenshotAlt: DeepSeek Harness plugin management page in Chinese, showing official plugins and a frosted workspace sidebar
Index.harnessFeat2Desc: Everything the model sees is recorded in an append-only session log: system prompts, reasoning, tool calls and results, subagent scheduling, and every context injection. In the Trajectory view, you can inspect these records by source. Resume, fork, search, and replay all operate on the same event stream.
Index.harnessFeat2Alt: Reconstruct a complete run from a single session log
Index.harnessFeat3Desc: Standard mode includes the full toolset. Code mode uses model-generated code to orchestrate multiple rounds of tool calls. Minimal mode keeps only a shell tool and a file editor for benchmarking models in a minimal environment. Creator mode lets you inspect the current runtime, test Cordis plugins in memory, and combine them into new modes.
Index.harnessModePlaceholder: Describe what you want to build
Index.harnessModeStandardDesc: Full coding agent with file editing, shell, file and web search, skills, planning, goals, subagents, and workflows.
Index.harnessModeCodeDesc: All Standard mode capabilities, with tools exposed through the Code Mode SDK so the model can combine multi-step operations in one TypeScript program.
Index.harnessModeMinimalDesc: Two-tool coding agent with persistent bash and str_replace_editor.
Index.harnessModeCordisDesc: Built for creating custom agent presets, with all Standard mode capabilities plus runtime inspection, plugin experiments, and preset-authoring guidance.
Index.harnessDemoDesc: Watch how you can customize page elements, tools, and agent presets in real time.
Index.harnessDemoAlt: DeepSeek Harness product feature demo video
Index.harnessUse1Desc:
Use Rental OS without maintaining servers. Open your workspace in a browser, with AI-led operations and the traditional console working together.

Enable additional capabilities as your business grows.
Index.harnessUse1Alt: DeepSeek Harness dark-mode Web UI analyzing a project and switching between Chat and Trajectory
Index.harnessUse2Desc:
Deploy Rental OS in your own environment, with tailored business features and system integrations.

Extend your operations with additional capabilities built on Rental Core.
Index.harnessUse2Alt: Clone, install, build, and launch the DeepSeek Harness Web UI from source
Index.harnessCtaTitle: Expand what rental can be, together
Index.harnessCtaDesc: We welcome industry partners, developers and service providers to turn real rental experience into reusable business capabilities. Around Rental Core, we connect industry needs, custom features and system integrations to build more flexible ways to run a rental business.
Index.harnessFeat3Alt: The new-session mode picker listing Standard, Code, Minimal, and Creator modes
